constraints: Use only generated, ordinary, nonspecial prime-order short-Weierstrass curves over prime fields.
Use actual affine elliptic coordinates and never expose scalar indices to a candidate compiler.
Hold each curve, factor base, two-sum output class, witness multiplicity, cap, and optimizer fixed across the candidate and controls.
Treat all executed results as TOY-EVIDENCE and MODEL-BOUND.
Do not infer relation generation, target descent, an exponent improvement, or a Pollard-rho break.
research_question.decision_target: Decide whether an elliptic-coordinate line invariant merits a larger structured-group embedding and recursive-decomposition study.
research_question.motivation: Existing coordinate-energy experiments vary factor-base geometry, while the structured-group embedding freezes a formal representative for each two-sum output. A fixed-chart coordinate-dependent section of each pair-sum fiber may change recursive closure conflicts without changing two-sum support or fiber multiplicity.

curve_families: generated ordinary prime-order short-Weierstrass curves with trace not equal to 0 or 1 and j not in {0,1728}
methods: fixed-chart affine secant and tangent line coefficients

research_question.title: Coordinate-aware representative selection for recursive EC embeddings
